title: Hourglass
tagline: Crowdfunding with money streaming through an NFT. An unique and better way to send funds to projects.
description:
Hourglass enables people to invest in the projects they like in an unique way.
Instead of sending the tokens to the project owner in one go, they are sent inside of an NFT. The tokens are progressively unlocked through a stream in the owner's wallet.
That way you'll make sure that the team doesn't spend everything from the start, not be motivated anymore and they'll feel that their time is truly being valued since they'll get tokens each seconds.
how_its_made:
We used Moralis for the Dapp and the Backend. Plus the external control of our Smart Contract.

Superfluid to stream the tokens from the NFT to the owner's wallet (we could also update the flow), Supefluid SDK for the frontend and SuperApp to create a ERC721 NFT.

And IPFS to save data from project's informations.
